// Schema generation fallback
// Request: A comprehensive fullstack task management application featuring a React frontend with dark mode support, task filtering, searching, and optimistic UI updates, backed by an Express REST API with Prisma ORM and SQLite. Includes request validation, toast notifications for user feedback, bulk task actions, and data export functionality.

INFERRED FEATURE SPECIFICATIONS (implement ALL of these):
- Task CRUD & Real-Time Validation: Create, read, update, and delete tasks with fields for title, description, priority level, and due date. Validates user input on both client and server before persisting to SQLite via Prisma. [zod, axios, lucide-react, date-fns] (User inputs task details → Client-side Zod validation → Express POST/PUT endpoint → Express Zod middleware validation → Prisma SQLite mutation → Response returned to frontend state update)
- Task Filtering, Search & Sorting: Filter tasks by status (All, Active, Completed), search by title/description keywords, and sort by due date or priority level. [lucide-react] (User changes filter/search state → Query parameters formatted → Express GET /api/tasks query → Prisma filtered database read → Rendered in React component with skeleton loaders)
- Optimistic Completion Toggle & Delete with Undo: Instantly toggle task completion status and delete tasks with optimistic UI updates and a temporary toast notification allowing users to undo deletion. [sonner, lucide-react] (User clicks completion toggle or delete → Immediate local state update → Async API call to Express → Prisma database update → Toast notification displayed with optional undo trigger)
- Dark Mode & Theme Persistence: Toggle between dark and light themes with automatic system preference detection and localStorage persistence to prevent theme flashing on reload. [lucide-react] (User toggles theme / System preference read → DOM root class updated ('dark') → Theme choice stored in browser LocalStorage)
- Bulk Actions & Data Export: Clear all completed tasks at once and export the current task list as a JSON or CSV file for backup. [lucide-react] (User clicks bulk delete / export → Express DELETE /api/tasks/completed OR client-side JSON/CSV generation → Prisma batch operation OR browser file download trigger)

Required libraries: express, @prisma/client, prisma, cors, zod, dotenv, react, react-dom, axios, lucide-react, date-fns, sonner, tailwindcss

Feature folders: client/src/components, client/src/hooks, client/src/services, client/src/types, server/src/controllers, server/src/routes, server/src/middleware, server/prisma

Each feature listed above is REQUIRED. Do not omit any of them.
Implement every data flow end-to-end. No mocked data. No placeholder UI.


DESIGN SYSTEM — MANDATORY USAGE:
A design system has been pre-generated at src/design-system/.
You MUST import reusable components from there:
  import { Button, Skeleton, EmptyState } from '../design-system/index.js';

Design Language for this project: elegant (inspired by Linear/Vercel/Stripe)
Color palette: blue brand + slate neutral
Spacing: 8px grid (multiples of 2, 4, 6, 8, 10, 12, 16...)
Border radius: md (consistent across ALL components)
Font: Inter

FORBIDDEN UI PATTERNS:
  ✗ Different border radii on different components (e.g. some rounded-2xl, some rounded-lg)
  ✗ Arbitrary gradient backgrounds not matching the brand palette
  ✗ Buttons larger than 56px height
  ✗ More than 4 different font sizes in a single view
  ✗ Inconsistent spacing that breaks the 8px grid
  ✗ Excessive glassmorphism (max 1 blur panel per page)
  ✗ Missing hover/focus/active states on ANY interactive element
  ✗ Icon-only buttons without aria-label
  ✗ No visible focus indicator (outline-none without focus-visible replacement)

REQUIRED UI PATTERNS:
  ✓ Every interactive element has hover + focus-visible state
  ✓ Destructive actions show a confirmation step before executing
  ✓ Every async operation has a loading skeleton (not just a spinner)
  ✓ Every data-absent state has an EmptyState component with a call-to-action
  ✓ Error states show the actual error message + a recovery action
  ✓ All inputs have labels (visible or aria-label)
  ✓ Responsive at sm (640px), md (768px), lg (1024px) breakpoints
